_about: Names for Hard Hat Mack's routines and globals, with the evidence for each.
Same contract as Karateka's: `recovered/` is gitignored because a
byte-identical reconstruction is the game, so what is kept is the reading.
Run build.ps1 to apply these to a freshly generated listing and get source
that still reassembles to the original.
Addresses are file offsets. A .COM loads at 0x100, so a listing address is
this plus 0x100. Globals are the same space -- one segment, no DS bias.
**This game is not compiled C.** It has zero `push bp` prologues and 427
`cmc` instructions: a mechanical translation of the 6502 original, where
every borrow has to be inverted because the two processors disagree about
the carry flag. So routines are enumerated by call target, not by prologue,
and probelib.py finds nothing here -- 0 of 250, which is a result and not
an empty run. There is no C runtime to identify.

0x0071: the INT 09h handler; comrec finds it from the vector install
0x00DF: decrements AL twice, branching to two different waits
0x0217: mul 7 by [0x6D9B] for the column, [0x6D9C] for the row, [0x6D97] for the shape; 42 callers
0x0268: the same, drawing two shapes at unit column scale
0x02B1: two shapes at the seven-pixel column scale
0x040A: what all three placement routines call once they have (col, row, shape)
0x0BB6: where the dispatch pointer at [0x0BD9] starts
0x14D8: calling it after start-up paints a whole level; see docs/03-the-code.md
0x2AFC: one of the three targets [0x6DAA] selects
0x45FB: moves [0x6DDA]/[0x6DDB] into [0x46F5]/[0x46F6] and takes a new value; 16 callers
0x648A: port 0x61 -- the only sound hardware this game touches

0x042D: 600 words: 0x0000, 0x2000, 0x0050, 0x2050 -- two CGA banks interleaved, one entry per scanline. The start-up code adds 5 to every entry before use.
0x0781: the entry stub clears it; four routines read it
0x0B60: 99 references, read and written by the actor routines around 0x1000
0x0BD9: `jmp word [0x0BD9]` -- recursive descent stops here; comrec resolves it to 0x0BB6
0x1B64: tested by 0x036D and 0x03DD straight after a placement
0x1B66: the three the placement routine tests before drawing
0x594F: written in exactly three places; see docs/02-architecture.md
0x5A2A: the score, one digit per byte, through 0x5A2C
0x6D97: 0, 768, 1024, 1280, 3072, 3328 -- multiples of 256, so a shape table index
0x6D9B: the placement column; the routine multiplies it by seven
0x6D9D: the second shape's column, in the pair routines
0x6DC8: 111 references, read and written by one cluster around 0x1600
0x6DDA: shift_history moves it into the history pair
0x726B: read by three routines, written by none -- a table, not a variable

_unnamed: 231 routines are reachable by a direct call and 18 are named. That is a
much thinner reading than Karateka's, and the reason is worth stating: a
6502 translation has no calling convention to lean on, no C runtime to
subtract, and no library whose functions have specifications you can probe
against. Every name here had to come from what the code does with its
